subject: general
question: The Government of India initiative ‘Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav’ to commemorate 75th Independence Day, commenced in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2021**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The official journey of “**Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav” commences on 12th March, 2021**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Point__**

__
 
• ​__**Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav"** is a national campaign launched by the **Government of India to commemorate the 75th anniversary of India's independence.** 
 
• It **celebrates the country's freedom** and its remarkable journey since gaining independence in 1947.
 
• The initiative was officially launched by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the Sabarmati Ashram in Gujarat.**
 
• It aims to **raise awareness of India’s freedom struggle**, its rich heritage, and future aspirations.
